setup: Release identical gray balls above the red and blue tiles at the same time.
name: Tile rebounds

oracle.name: Tile rebounds
oracle.law: At each new floor impact, both gray balls and movable apparatus parts have vertical restitution e=0.9 on the red tile and e=0.15 on the blue tile. Hinged and sliding parts are included.
oracle.plain: Identical balls bounce high on red tiles and low on blue tiles.
oracle.plain_zh: 一样的球，在红地砖上弹得高，在蓝地砖上弹得低。
oracle.condition: A new downward floor impact occurs on a colored tile.
oracle.effect: Red returns 90% of the vertical speed; blue returns only 15%.
oracle.scope: The rule follows the surface. Gray balls and movable apparatus parts are included.

reference: Same geometry, masses and scripted actions; the altered program is disabled only in the ordinary-physics reference.
